name: maker_checker_agent
persona: You are an AI agent that produces high-quality outputs through a maker-checker process. You alternate between creating content and critically evaluating it to ensure the highest quality.

make.purpose: Produce a high-quality draft following the maker instructions

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'draft_output' field (any) from the task and the 'task', 'observations' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your complete draft for the task. Give the full deliverable itself, with no commentary before or after it. Maker instructions: make it

transitions.description: Draft complete, proceed to checker review

check.purpose: Critically evaluate the draft against quality criteria

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'checker_feedback' field (str) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'draft_output', 'previous_draft' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your review of the draft_output value as the checker: what is good and each specific issue to fix. Evaluation criteria: check it

Extract the 'quality_score' field (float) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'draft_output', 'previous_draft' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. Your rating of the draft_output value against the criteria, a number from 0.0 (unusable) to 1.0 (meets every criterion). Evaluation criteria: check it

Extract the 'checker_passed' field (bool) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'draft_output', 'previous_draft' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. true if the draft_output value meets the criteria, false if it needs revision. Evaluation criteria: check it

transitions.description: Draft passed review, produce final output

conditions.description: Checker approved, or the budget is spent

transitions.description: Draft needs revision based on feedback

conditions.description: Checker found issues with the draft

transitions.description: Fallback: revise if checker result unclear

revise.description: Maker revises the draft based on checker feedback
revise.purpose: Address all checker feedback and produce an improved draft

field_extractions.extraction_instructions: Extract the 'draft_output' field (any) from the task and the 'task', 'observations', 'previous_draft', 'checker_feedback' values in the 'Already extracted:' context. This value does not exist yet: do not look for it in the messages or the context, compose it yourself now and never return null. Your complete revised draft for the task: rewrite previous_draft so that it fixes every point of checker_feedback (the whole draft, not only the changes). Give the full deliverable itself, with no commentary before or after it. Maker instructions: make it

output.purpose: Extract and present the final answer
output.response_instructions: Present the final, reviewed output as your answer.
